title: Certainty San Francisco 2027
summary: Join Certainty 2027 in San Francisco on February 18, 2027. One day of keynotes, stage-based tracks, and panels for biotech founders and pharma development leaders. Save your spot.
body_markdown:
ShareShareShare


## Certainty 2027, Confidence at every phase


### San Francisco, February 18, 2027, one day built around where you are in drug development


**Date:** Thursday, February 18, 2027


Agenda and venue coming soon


Whether you’re a VP of Clinical Pharmacology running a global portfolio, or a founder who’s also your company’s only regulatory strategist, Certainty 2027 is built for you, a single day shaped around the decisions you’re actually facing.


## Who should attend


If you’re a founder, CEO, or Head of Development at an emerging biotech, often wearing the regulatory, clinical, and scientific hats all at once, this day is built to help you figure out what’s next: whether to build or partner, whether your program has what it needs to get to IND, and what it takes to be ready for your next funding round or a potential acquisition.


If you’re a VP or Director of Clinical Pharmacology, Regulatory Affairs, Toxicology, or DMPK at a larger organization scaling a global portfolio, you’ll see what it takes to apply MIDD at scale, the capacity, speed, and confidence to move more programs forward without losing rigor.


## What to expect


A full day built around real decisions: an opening keynote on how AI, and the regulatory frameworks Certara has helped shape, are changing the path to approval, track content built around your stage of development, and real conversations, including panels with clients, investors, and industry leaders, not just case studies.


The venue and full agenda will be announced soon, and early registrants will get priority notice. Space is limited, save your spot today.
